core_invariants_LR.requirement: Complete main generation and bounded capture before CPU review, repair inference or delivery of answer text; verify supported upstream completion, not socket closure alone; no provisional original text to the user.
CPU evidence selects eligible suspicion; none -> original unchanged and ZERO review calls, including shadow/strict; missing evidence does not prove error.
CPU preassigns original-coordinate word/short-phrase targets, not model tokens or unrestricted sentences; the model cannot expand, reposition or invent IDs.
Ask expression suitability in the preserved question; allow keep / insufficient context / wider-edit decline; do not demand a change or treat stylistic preference as correction.

Construct a fresh isolated review request/history; no main session IDs, previous_response_id, conversation linkage, tools, images, tool results or project constitutions/context reconstruction; no recursion through repair/public adapter.
Review is an untrusted local proposal; code validates and inserts exact replacements; the model never regenerates the answer or supplies replacement sentences.

Preserve all original substrings outside accepted spans, protected content, whitespace, line endings, diacritics and formatting; no reserialization/detokenization (owner: exact original spans and established protection behavior).
core_invariants_LR.note: owner scope reaffirms this as a mandatory focus

core_invariants_LR.requirement: Preserve EXACT/CENSORED/UNAVAILABLE evidence semantics; missing truncated data is not zero; EXACT(0) requires justified query completeness; unknown denominator remains unknown.

Strict acceptance requires appropriate independent corpus/lexicon/morphology evidence and no detected contradiction; frequency or model confidence alone cannot authorize change; same-Qwen second call is not statistically independent evidence.
Bounded one-pass initial review; at most one combined request; no automatic generative repair/retry loop, including malformed-JSON repair; CPU revalidation only.
Optional repair failure preserves only the already safely captured original; never mask main error, incompleteness or hard capture limit as successful output.
Reuse the existing Qwen through an authorized client; CPU infrastructure must not load a second large GPU model or alter the protected deployment/resources.
Production logs exclude user text, targets/replacements, prompts, raw responses and secrets; permitted evaluation is a separate explicitly controlled channel.
Software correctness, serving compatibility, linguistic benefit and deployment/release authority require distinct evidence; goals/defaults are not measurements.

capture_and_delivery.requirement: Adapter owns main-response capture and delivery; the library operates on already completed text; request-local immutable input per response; no shared mutable history or buffers.
Completion is verified per the explicitly supported upstream protocol (finish semantics), not socket closure; main failure/truncation never enters the successful CAPTURED path.
Capture is bounded; hard capture limit exceeded -> bounded API failure, never truncated text labelled complete.
Select only explicitly supported assistant-text fields; never recursively repair every string in a response object.
Initial adapter bypasses entire responses containing tool calls or unsupported structures; unknown response structures are not repaired.
State machine per response: MAIN_FINISHED -> CAPTURED -> ANALYZED -> (RETURNED_ORIGINAL | REVIEWED -> (RETURNED_ORIGINAL | VALIDATED -> (RETURNED_ORIGINAL | PATCHED -> RETURNED_FINAL))).

span_and_original_mapping.requirement: Span coordinates are Python-string Unicode code-point indices into the UNMODIFIED original: 0<=start<end<=len(text); text[start:end]==original; span_id unique per response; no protected intersection; not UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 units or model tokens.
Repeated identical substrings distinguished by exact before_target/target/after_target; no reliance on first-occurrence search.
Normalization/casefold/linguistic tokenization operate on derived views only; original preserves whitespace, line endings, diacritics, punctuation and all characters outside accepted spans.
Combining marks, emoji and CRLF require explicit tests; unsafe partial-grapheme targeting abstains rather than damages the source.

Result carries final text, changed flag, original-coordinate edits, suspicion/decision metadata, counted review calls and timings; local inspection metadata is not permission for production logs or main chat.

protected_material.requirement: Protect fenced/indented code, inline code, URLs and link destinations, emails, filesystem paths, commands, numbers/units, citations/quotes and other machine-significant strings.
Tools/functions, IDs, schemas, structured JSON output, reasoning fields, images and binary data are uneditable; initial adapter bypasses such responses entirely.
Proper names, titles, technical terms and mixed languages require conservative exclusions or a clearly bounded terminology policy; unclear Markdown abstains.
Protected intervals are linguistic boundaries: token lists must never manufacture bigram/trigram adjacency across removed excluded material.
Markdown parsing may locate spans, but Markdown reserialization is not an acceptable patcher; no detokenization or renderer may substitute for the original document.
protected_material.note: owner: Pandoc is the mandatory installed versioned structural parser with a startup check (see O1)

corpus_and_evidence.requirement: Evidence records carry source/version, normalization/tagging, scope, completeness/cutoff and status EXACT|CENSORED|UNAVAILABLE; EXACT(0) only with justified completeness.
Full context denominator separately marked known/unknown; retained n-gram sums are not a complete denominator; censored surface-form aggregation is not a complete lemma distribution.

Comparisons require compatible source scope, normalization and units; conservative ratio bounds may inform evidence but are not semantic proof; different-length phrase raw counts alone cannot authorize an edit.

Every imported index has a manifest: source identity/version, acquisition reference/checksum, rights/license, format, threshold/cutoff, completeness, normalization/tagging, importer version, deterministic build parameters; import is repeatable.
Preserve attribution and redistribution conditions; public query access does not authorize bulk extraction/redistribution; no runtime corpus scraping; no downloads or network calls on package import.
Large indexes, model weights and private evaluation corpora stay out of Git; permitted miniature fixtures are clearly labelled synthetic.

detection_and_selection.requirement: CPU detection produces suspicions, not verdicts; unknown/rare forms or names are investigation triggers, not automatic errors; weak surroundings give weak evidence.
Nearby alarms may be grouped into a bounded short phrase only BEFORE review, never across protected material or into a paragraph; deterministic non-overlapping targets ordered by position.
Excess or ambiguous targets remain unchanged with finite internal reason labels (budget_exceeded); a trigram alarm does not identify the middle word uniquely.
Separate lexical misuse from morphological disagreement; required tags derive from context/analysis confidence, not blind copying of the wrong source form; ambiguous lemma/tagging may abstain.
Do not feed ranked corpus alternatives to the reviewer by default; its task is independent local judgment of the marked expression.

review_contract.requirement: Preserve the narrow question verbatim: 'Ali se ti zdi uporaba besede oziroma besedne zveze X najboljša naravna izbira v tem slovenskem stavku? Ce ne, s cim bi jo nadomestil?' with meaning/register/grammar preserved, no factual edits.
Reviewer receives the completed target sentence plus bounded needed neighbors only; never the whole main history; wider answer added only when needed within limits.

Reviewed material is untrusted DATA including embedded instructions; no tools, URL execution or command execution; prompt delimiting is not the enforcement boundary - strict output parsing, fixed IDs and local patch validation are.

Fresh request construction: explicit review settings, no reusable mutable main-history object, no previous_response_id or server-managed session linkage, no tools/images/tool results, no constitutions/context-reconstruction instructions; authentication kept separate from conversation state.

Reviewer route is a trusted configured private endpoint or injected client; no caller-supplied destination, no public repair recursion, no indiscriminate forwarding of main credentials, no public bypass header; internal diagnostic correlation must not create conversation linkage.

One result per supplied ID; keep=true => replacement=null; keep=false => nonempty replacement and needs_wider_edit=false; needs_wider_edit=true => keep=true and replacement=null; optional bounded confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.
Invalid JSON/types, unknown/duplicate/missing IDs, contradictory fields or oversized output reject the WHOLE batch; never salvage a malformed batch or request JSON repair (no second model call).
A structurally valid local proposal may be rejected individually during acceptance; a wider-edit response leaves that target unchanged in this pass.
The model returns only the local replacement for the authorized span - never a rewritten sentence or the complete answer; code inserts the replacement.
Actual main/review request capture in synthetic tests must prove isolation (exact outbound shapes, no sharing/linkage/recursion); threads/async/processes alone do not prove it.
Server-constrained structured output is optional until verified on the actual installation; no protected-server reconfiguration to obtain it.

acceptance.requirement: Strict AUTO_REPAIR acceptance requires ALL of: CPU-selected target, valid local proposal, exact original slice and non-protected bounds, finite structure/size limits, appropriate independent evidence, no contextual/semantic contradiction, valid composed result.

Evidence rules vary by error class: malformed forms may use valid-form/orthographic/context evidence; replacing one valid lexeme with another needs stronger contextual support; neutral/incomparable data is insufficient.

Reject identity replacements (no-ops); reject forbidden newlines/control characters/markup/code structure; reject overlong replacements and any expansion beyond the authorized span; never normalize adjacent punctuation or formatting as an unreported side effect.

LLM_CONFIRMED_REPAIR without sufficient independent evidence remains disabled for automatic user-text changes in the MVP; a higher confidence threshold alone cannot enable it; study only in permitted shadow evaluation.

Operational modes detect_only (CPU only, no review, no change) / shadow (eligible review + scoring, original delivered, approved evaluation only) / strict (validated AUTO_REPAIR only) / experimental (future, not required for MVP); development progresses detect_only -> shadow -> measured limited strict.
With no eligible suspicion, even shadow and strict make zero review requests and deliver the unchanged original.

patching_and_composition.requirement: The original remains immutable until final composition; each selected original slice is re-validated immediately before application.
Overlapping or incompatible edits are rejected; no silent last-wins selection.

Compose the final result from untouched original slices plus approved replacements, or an equivalently tested descending-offset implementation; no model answer, detokenization or Markdown renderer substitutes for the document.
Recheck affected sentences/local contexts after composition; conflicting nearby changes roll back as a group and rebuild from the original; bounded CPU check only, no new generative pass.
No surviving edit => byte-exact original text.

Text equality and HTTP-byte equality are distinct: on the unchanged path preserve original envelope bytes where possible; on the changed path serialize only supported envelope transformations and account explicitly for affected metadata.

http_api_and_history.requirement: Start with one explicitly supported nonstreaming text shape and one response choice; actual endpoint/schema selected and tested in order; no universal Chat/Responses compatibility claim.

Reject unsupported request capabilities before the main call where possible, or route through an explicitly configured unchanged bypass; never silently treat stream=true as permission to return plain JSON under an SSE contract.
Upstream may stream internally, but the adapter accumulates under a hard bound and validates completion before CPU analysis; no provisional answer text to the user.
No JSON masquerading as SSE; no rewriting of tool results; no accidental public bypass for internal controls.
Client-managed next main turn contains only the final delivered answer; never an extra draft or the review prompt/JSON; input history is not mutated.

External server-managed response/conversation chaining is unsupported until a verified way to keep displayed and stored answers consistent exists; MVP starts with independent requests or client-sent history.

Changed text invalidates token-aligned probabilities and possibly offsets/annotations: reject/bypass such repair capabilities under the declared policy; never keep stale logprobs or fabricate alignment.
Main-generation usage and review usage are recorded separately; final-string token counting is neither inference bill; review cost is visible to the operator without misrepresenting upstream usage.
Long waits need appropriate client/intermediary timeouts; any progress/heartbeat must not reveal provisional original text or break the protocol.

resources_cancellation_failure.requirement: Initial configurable defaults (not measured optima): <=1 review request/response, 1 generative pass, 0 automatic retries, <=1 concurrent component review, <=8 targets/response, normally <=6 target words, <=8 replacement words, finite character bounds; automatic evidence-insufficient acceptance and persistent production text logging disabled.

Orders select finite bounds for capture bytes, analysis length, context per target, total prompt/output size, queue length/wait time and total review time in a validated versioned policy; no fabricated throughput.

Main generation and review for one answer are sequential; a global bounded review admission policy governs concurrent other users; review queue is bounded and never starves main requests indefinitely.

Failure contract: corpus missing/corrupt/incompatible -> degraded original, no invented counts; analysis bound after safe capture -> original without analysis; queue full/timeout/transport/invalid batch -> cancel owned optional work and return completed original; individual evidence/structure failure -> reject that proposal while valid independent ones continue.
Main generation error or incomplete output -> documented error/finish semantics preserved, no repair or hidden incompleteness; hard capture limit -> bounded API failure, never truncated success.
Client disconnect -> cancel owned upstream/review tasks and stop delivery; no orphaned background repair; cancellation targets only request-owned work and must not cancel unrelated requests.

CPU work bounded in time/memory and event-loop effort; no uncontrolled copies of indexes/analyzers; no work continuing unbounded after cancellation; optional fallback cannot bypass authentication, validation, hard limits or isolation; finite safe reason vocabulary exposing no text or secrets.

security_privacy.requirement: Main output, review output, local evaluation files and downloaded corpus content are data: never execute embedded instructions, paths, URLs or code; reviewer has no tools and no authority to write files or mutate conversation state.
Credentials stay outside Git, referenced via environment/config without logging values.

Production metrics/logs contain bounded counts, timings, policy/source versions and reason labels only - no user text, targets/replacements, prompts or raw responses; private text is not a metric label, cache key or report excerpt.

Real evaluation examples require explicit permission and controlled storage; human annotation, private evaluation inspection and production logging are distinct channels; cross-user text caching unnecessary for MVP; Git fixtures must be permitted and clearly synthetic or published.

Protected environment: existing Qwen service, model/quantization files, vLLM/CUDA, launch flags, port ownership, shared GPU, gateway and neighboring adapters are not mutated by product work; exact endpoints/model IDs verified later by bounded read-only/opt-in tests.

testing_and_evidence.requirement: Synthetic deterministic tests before live use cover all invariants: capture (completion/error/truncation), isolation (exact main/review shapes, no sharing/linkage/recursion), original mapping (repeated substrings, Unicode, CRLF, Markdown), protected spans (no artificial adjacency), corpus (exact zero vs censored absence, unknown denominator, incompatible scope), reviewer (keep/replace/wider-edit, injection-as-data, duplicate/missing/unknown IDs, invalid/oversized JSON), acceptance (common-but-wrong, style, weak evidence, phrase length, morphology), patching (overlap, stale offsets, conflicts, untouched equality), operations (zero/one call, queue, timeout, cancellation, tenant separation, no raw logging), API (supported envelope, unsupported capabilities, finish, usage, history).

The fake-upstream test must directly verify both model calls: the repair request carries no link to the main conversation and no disallowed main history; the main history after the test contains no repair JSON.

Before accepting live Qwen: verify model ID, supported API shape, thinking/structured-output rules, valid cancellation and actual usage; documented state of the old installation is not a substitute; live tests are explicit opt-in, small and low-concurrency; a skipped live test is not a pass.

Linguistic evaluation (MVP criterion axis): real target outputs plus correct/rare/technical negative controls, human labels distinguishing error/style/alternative/wider-edit, frozen calibration/held-out splits without leakage, Qwen never the final judge of its own changes; report accepted-edit precision, harmful edits per 10k correct words, style edits, coverage, call rate, separate usage, latency/resource/failure with sample sizes and uncertainty.
testing_and_evidence.note: owner scope: no separate human evaluation dataset and no research restart in this order; assessed from evidence existing at the audited main only

testing_and_evidence.requirement: Approximate 99% precision and <=1 harmful edit/10k correct words are goals, not results or release authority; zero events in a small sample proves no zero rate; useful benefit with bounded harm must both be demonstrated; abstention-heavy behavior is not automatically success.

closure_audit_governance.requirement: Before any MVP-complete/closure claim: a fresh independent audit (fresh isolated context or human) starts from human scope + full architecture + current merged main (not strategic queue claims); classifies every requirement IMPLEMENTED/PARTIAL/ABSENT/UNPROVEN; links actual runtime paths, entry points, tests and exact revision; treats reports/README/CI summaries as claims; converts gaps to provenance-linked bounded work; repeats after remediation; strategy recommends closure, the human retains the milestone label and deployment judgment.
closure_audit_governance.note: this order 032-a executes that independent closure audit for the owner-selected functional scope

demonstrator_D.requirement: Contracts and policy: clear span/evidence/proposal/result structures; separate keep vs replace.
Bounded data import: repeatable index of the initial sources with manifest and correct missing-data distinction (EXACT/CENSORED/UNAVAILABLE).
Protection and mapping: tokenization without modifying the original; tests for code, URLs and Unicode.
First CPU detector: selects marked suspicious places on a small set, does not send everything to the model.
Isolated reviewer: fake and real Qwen clients return validated local decisions.
Acceptance and patcher: code accepts or rejects proposals and preserves all other segments.
CLI and first review: display of original, proposals, final text and reasons; real examples are not embedded special rules.

experimental_mvp_M.requirement: Initial labelled set: real answers, correct control cases and a separate threshold-tuning part.
experimental_mvp_M.note: MVP-stage evidence requirement; owner excludes a separate human evaluation dataset and research restart in this order - no new labelled dataset work; only evidence already present at the audited main is assessed.

experimental_mvp_M.requirement: Lemmas and morphology: verified CPU analysis separating wrong lexeme choice from wrong inflection.
Short phrases: bounded alarm grouping, clear edit width and working needs_wider_edit.
Acceptance calibration: rule versions, precision/harm/coverage measurements by error class.
experimental_mvp_M.note: MVP-stage evidence requirement; calibration on new human-labelled data is excluded by owner scope; existing calibration evidence at the audited main only.

experimental_mvp_M.requirement: Limits and failures: queue, cancellation, time and size bounds, safe return to original.
Nonstreaming API path: one clearly supported text shape; context preserved, no recursion.
Comparative report: comparison of the agreed method with the original and basic baseline methods.
experimental_mvp_M.note: MVP-stage evidence deliverable; producing a new comparative research report would be the excluded research-restart work; existing report evidence at the audited main only.

verified_service_S.requirement: Wider negative tests: more correct and technical text; statistically meaningful harm report.
verified_service_S.note: Verified-service stage (045-055); not a functional-MVP readiness criterion; also overlaps the owner-excluded human evaluation dataset work.

verified_service_S.requirement: Wider data support: collocations or more complete n-grams when measurements show benefit; usage rights arranged.
Production integration: explicit gateway path, separate repair usage, bounded load.
Installation and rollback: packaging, health checks, configuration, repair switchable off without changing Qwen.
Final documentation: supported/unsupported cases, data versions, known limits, repeatable tests.

plan_section16_criteria.requirement: Celoten glavni odgovor je prevzet pred popravljalnim klicem in pred prikazom uporabniku - the whole main answer is captured before the repair call and before user display.
Brez zadostnega suma ni dodatnega Qwenovega klica - without sufficient suspicion there is no additional Qwen call.
Qwen sme predlagati samo zamenjavo dodeljenega razpona ali odgovoriti 'pusti' - Qwen may only propose a replacement of the assigned span or answer keep.
Glavna zgodovina ne vsebuje popravljalnega pogovora ali njegovih internih rezultatov - the main history contains no repair conversation or its internal results.
Nobena sprememba se ne zgodi zunaj programsko potrjenih razponov - no change happens outside programmatically verified spans.
Neveljaven predlog ali odpoved izbirnega postopka ne poskoduje ze dokoncanega odgovora - an invalid proposal or optional-step failure does not damage the already completed answer.
Objavljene odrezane frekvence se ne obravnavajo kot popolna statistika - published truncated frequencies are not treated as complete statistics.
Obstaja pregledno porocilo o koristi, skodi, zakasnitvi in dodatni porabi - a transparent report of benefit, harm, latency and additional usage exists.
plan_section16_criteria.note: usage/latency/harm reporting axis: functional usage separation is in scope; benefit/harm quantification on a separate human evaluation dataset is owner-excluded in this order.

reconciliation.summary: LR-001..LR-014 are all applicable to the functional proxy. The 13 derived areas (F-*) restate and decompose the PLAN/ARCH behavioral obligations that the LRs compress; every in-scope row is assessed in this audit. D01-D07 are the prior demonstrator stage whose functional content the runnable proxy must contain. M01-M07 are the MVP work cluster; M01/M04/M07 carry the owner exclusion (no new human evaluation dataset / no research restart) so only pre-existing evidence at the audited main is assessed. S01-S05 are the verified-service stage and are later-stage: not functional-MVP readiness criteria and not assessed in this audit. C1-C8 are the eight mandatory MVP criteria, all in scope, with C8's benefit/harm quantification axis subject to the owner exclusion. O1-O4 are owner-scope requirements layered on the canonical sources (Pandoc mandate, runnable-proxy subject, exact-span/protection preservation, fresh re-derivation).
